summary.content:
Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Musk says basis of charitable giving at stake in OpenAI lawsuit
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours
